name: @thetis/host-grants
description: The grants that need the host: which host directories are bound into a person's fence, which ssh keys its agent holds, and the installation's repository keys -- one ssh key per repository, held by the system fence. An admin grants them; a person manages their own keys and reads their own mounts. A host package: loaded by the daemon per call as host.grants.<export>, never installed into a fence.
